entities.summary: Julio Argentino Roca, a notable figure in the history of Argentina, associated with Independence, Civil Wars, and National Organization (1852–1880). Preceded by Constitution and Battle of Caseros — Urquiza defeats Rosas, February 3, 1852. Their legacy influenced Argentine Constitution adopted — May 1, 1853 and Conquest of the Desert under General Roca — 1879.
